summary: 36-year-old woman fell while hiking the Ute Trail near Aspen with a friend; Mountain Rescue Aspen searched in the dark, carried her out with injuries and hypothermia, reaching the trailhead ~10 p.m.; taken to hospital.
responding_agency: Pitkin County Sheriff's Office; Mountain Rescue Aspen
notes: Friend called for help by cellphone; EMSWorld reprint of 2011 DenverChannel report.
